The '''Jumai''' are a sept of the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]].

[[Sevanna]] is of the Jumai sept and the Jumai all accompanied her to [[Ghealdan]]. They were the last sept to go through one of [[Caddar]]'s gateways. Sevanna also brought all the channeling [[Wise One]]s with her.{{verify}}

There were almost twice as many ''[[gai'shain]]'' with Sevanna's Shaido in [[Malden]] as there were Jumai, her own people.{{verify}}

Aiel of the Jumai sept had a disagreement with the ''[[Mera'din]]'' - the Jumai said that the ''Mera'din'' would not get their share of the land's plunder (the "[[fifth]]") because they are not part of their sept, yet [[Kinhuin]] argued that it was because the ''Mera'din'' were twice the number of Jumai and it would mean that the Jumai would get less if they have to share. He brings this matter to the [[Wise One]]s.

[[Melindhra]] was also of the Jumai sept.{{verify}}
